_comment: Durable evidence for snapshot.md's claims — audit-code R2/M7 fix. Full output of a throwaway scan (adapted from wine-cellar-app's own docs/migration/tools/frontend-inventory-scan.mjs detection regexes) run against a detached worktree at commit 274ad342, filtered to kebab/colon-shaped custom event names. This is the independent verification that (a) each of the 7 events had ZERO listeners anywhere in the 356-file public/js/ tree at this commit, and (b) no other kebab/colon-named dispatch-only event existed at this commit beyond these 7 — closing the 'is this really all of them, and were they really unconsumed' gap a hand-minimized fixture pack cannot answer on its own.
note: Every entry's listeners array is empty, verified against the same 356-file scan that found the dispatchers — this is the independent confirmation the plan's field-evidence table (§0) rests on, reconstructed rather than trusted. The scan script itself was throwaway (not committed, per the repo's generated-artifact policy — it was a one-time historical re-derivation, not a reusable tool) and this JSON is its captured output.
